tspan.tspan: patch a live .bin (overwrites target, or writes [output.bin])
all banks of a language folder -> one combined TOML
combined TOML -> banks patched in the language folder

text.tspan: - Only equal-length strings are patched in place (byte-exact).
- Any length change triggers a full CAFF rebuild: LSBL offset table,
size fields and header checksum are recalculated automatically.
